summary: Phase 9.5c+ validation. Backend fully green: 695/695 pytest passing, Golden Corpus 51/51 = 100.0%, all 15 originals (GC-001..GC-015) still pass, all 18 benign enterprise samples (GC-150..GC-167) rate Benign/Suspicious (no Malicious/Critical FPs), latency dict populated with mean_ms=0.264, p50=0.185, p95=0.617, p99=0.994, max=0.994, total_ms=13.44 and every SampleResult has duration_ms > 0. golden_delta.py exits 0 and emits both 'Pipeline latency (ms per sample)' section and '✅ **PASS**'. Frontend compiles successfully; backend /api/rc5/parse returns 200 with exec_graph/behaviors/mitre/lolbins_v2/verdict_v2/explain. E2E analyst flow: login OK, /analyst/rc5 renders 3 of 4 requested panels (execution-graph-panel, behavior-timeline-panel, mitre-drilldown-panel visible; mitre row expansion works, showing sigma detection snippet + evidence node IDs). Two data-key mismatches break the sticky-verdict-header rendering and empty-state the execution graph.

ui_bugs.issue: Sticky verdict header never renders. Line 138 checks `rc5?.verdict` but the /api/rc5/parse response uses key `verdict_v2` (no `verdict` field at top level). Result: <StickyVerdictHeader data-testid='sticky-verdict-header'> is never mounted after Analyze. Fix: change condition to `rc5?.verdict_v2` and pass `verdict={rc5.verdict_v2}`.

Execution graph panel renders but shows empty state 'No execution graph yet — analyze a sample first.' even after a successful Analyze. Line 229 passes `graph={rc5.graph}` but backend returns the graph under key `exec_graph` (contains nodes + schema_version). Fix: change to `graph={rc5.exec_graph}`.

integration_issues.issue: Frontend/backend key contract drift: page references rc5.verdict and rc5.graph; API contract uses verdict_v2 and exec_graph. Behaviors/mitre/mitre_navigator keys match correctly.

action_items: In /app/frontend/src/pages/AnalystRC5Page.jsx line 138-143: replace `rc5?.verdict` with `rc5?.verdict_v2` and prop `verdict={rc5.verdict_v2}` so the StickyVerdictHeader mounts.

In /app/frontend/src/pages/AnalystRC5Page.jsx line 229: replace `graph={rc5.graph}` with `graph={rc5.exec_graph}` so ExecutionGraphSVG receives its nodes array (backend already returns exec_graph.nodes).
After both fixes, re-run analyst E2E to confirm sticky-verdict-header + execution-graph-svg render.
critical_code_review_comments: Prop-plumbing bug in AnalystRC5Page.jsx: page uses rc5.verdict_v2 in one code path (line 359) but rc5.verdict for the sticky header (line 138) — inconsistent naming inside the same file.
No frontend normalization of API response — a small selector/adapter function (e.g. extractGraph, extractVerdict) would prevent silent key drift when the backend contract evolves.

success_rate.frontend: 75% (3 of 4 required data-testid panels functional post-Analyze)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend / corpus / latency / delta CLI are all fully green per Phase 9.5c+ charter. Only frontend prop-plumbing in AnalystRC5Page.jsx needs a two-line fix (verdict_v2 + exec_graph). After the fix, verify sticky-verdict-header is visible with data-testid='sticky-verdict-header' and that ExecutionGraphSVG renders SVG nodes (not the empty-state <text>). Backend contract keys: verdict_v2 (object), exec_graph (object with nodes[]), behaviors (array), mitre (array), mitre_navigator (object).
rca of the issue: RC: Frontend AnalystRC5Page.jsx was patched to consume 4 new SOC-Prime components, but two prop bindings reference legacy/renamed API keys (`rc5.verdict`, `rc5.graph`) that never existed in the /api/rc5/parse payload — the real keys are `verdict_v2` and `exec_graph`. Repro: login as admin, navigate /analyst/rc5, click Analyze. Backend returns HTTP 200 with populated verdict_v2 + exec_graph, but React sees `rc5.verdict === undefined` (gate fails, sticky header never mounts) and `rc5.graph === undefined` (ExecutionGraphSVG renders its empty-state placeholder). Mitigation: change line 138 gate + line 140 prop to verdict_v2, and line 229 prop to exec_graph. No backend change needed.
